info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Product Design API
info.description: The Update Product Design API enables businesses to modify existing product design details within the banking product management system. By utilizing this API, users can easily update specifications, features, and configurations of product designs identified by their unique design ID. This is particularly useful for product managers and design teams looking to adapt products to market changes or customer feedback. Streamlining the design modification process enhances agility in product management, ensuring that offerings remain relevant and competitive.

put.description: This endpoint allows the user to update the details of a specific product design identified by its unique ID (RES-100045). It provides the necessary functionality to reflect changes in design attributes, enhancing product management capabilities.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the design details for a specific product identified by RES-100045. The provided data must conform to the schema defined for this operation.
